violation_type.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption with HS Diploma/GED -Completed  Child-care Career Program Approved by TEA/TEPSAC (26 TAC §746.1109(a)(3)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption with HS Diploma/GED -Completed  Child-care Career Program Approved by TEA/TEPSAC
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation employed a caregiver who has graduated from high school and is under the age of 18 who was not enrolled nor completed a childcare career program.

finding_variants.text: The operation employed a caregiver who has graduated from high school and is under the age of 18 who was not enrolled nor completed a childcare career program.
Staff hired on 2/3/2025 is not enrolled and has not completed Child-Care Career Program.
There is no documentation showing the two 17 year olds are enrolled or completed the career development program at their high school.

Follow up 7/19/22: The caregivers, who are under 18,  are still not enrolled or have completed the career development courses in high school.    Note: A waiver has been turned in for the three caregivers.
A caregiver did not have documentation of being enrolled in a Child Developmental Program. The only documentation on file was a course in Child Development.
